value.rationale: For all finite positive-size part lists and real positive weights, the classification determines every morphism (not merely existence) and the entire continuous block-isomorphism geometry. It proves the 2017 zero-or-isomorphism conjectured dichotomy for the natural singular family of complete multipartite graphs; nonmonomial orthogonal maps show why nonsingular/monomial arguments are inadequate. The result is an all-parameter structural theorem with a natural motivating open problem, rather than an arbitrary finite cutoff.
